info.title: cast
info.description: Scaffolds initial PlantUML sequence diagrams from command-line participants and messages.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: cast — scaffold initial PlantUML sequence diagrams from the command line.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Scaffold a PlantUML sequence diagram from participants and messages.

options.name: --participant
options.description: A participant as '[kind:]alias[:Display Name]'. Repeatable. Run 'cast kinds' to list kinds.

options.name: --message
options.description: A message as 'Source -> Target : label'. Repeatable.

options.name: --title
options.description: Diagram title.

options.name: --autonumber
options.description: Emit 'autonumber' so PlantUML numbers each message. [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: PlantUML theme name (emits '!theme <name>').

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file (defaults to cast.puml in the current directory).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write the diagram to standard output instead of a file (takes precedence over --output). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --no-sample
options.description: When no --message is supplied, do not generate a placeholder flow. [default: False]

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #AZURE).

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the written file in Notepad. [default: False]

commands.name: kinds
commands.description: List the participant kinds usable as the 'kind:' prefix in --participant.

commands.name: ng
commands.description: Diagram how Angular injects dependencies into any inject()-using construct (service, component, function, …).

options.name: --service
options.description: Path to the Angular .ts file to inspect (service, component, directive, pipe, interceptor, guard, resolver, or function).

options.name: --title
options.description: Diagram title (defaults to a generated 'How Angular injects … into <Name>').

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file (defaults to the source path with a .puml extension, e.g. foo.service.ts -> foo.service.puml).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write the diagram to standard output instead of a file (takes precedence over --output). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #AZURE).

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the written file in Notepad. [default: False]

commands.name: calls
commands.description: Diagram the call graph of each public method/function in a TypeScript file.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to the TypeScript .ts file to inspect.

options.name: --method
options.description: Diagram only this method/function (matched by name, any visibility). Repeatable.

options.name: --include-private
options.description: Include non-public members too (default: public members only). [default: False]

options.name: --title
options.description: Diagram title (defaults to a generated 'Call graph of <Name>').

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file (defaults to the source path with a .puml extension, e.g. order.service.ts -> order.service.puml).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write the diagram to standard output instead of a file (takes precedence over --output). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #AZURE).

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the written file in Notepad. [default: False]

commands.name: style
commands.description: Apply the default styling (teoz pragma, font size 10, double participant box) to existing PlantUML sequence diagrams.

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #AZURE).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a .puml file, or a folder to scan recursively for .puml files.

commands.name: template
commands.description: Render a saved diagram template, or manage templates with save/list/show/delete.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the saved template to render.

options.name: --message
options.description: A message as 'Source -> Target : label', replacing the template's stored messages. Repeatable.

options.name: --title
options.description: Diagram title overriding the template's stored title.

options.name: --autonumber
options.description: Emit 'autonumber' even when the template doesn't (the flag can only switch numbering on). [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: PlantUML theme name overriding the template's stored theme.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the diagram to this file (defaults to cast.puml in the current directory).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write the diagram to standard output instead of a file (takes precedence over --output). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --no-sample
options.description: When the template stores no messages and no --message is supplied, do not generate a placeholder flow. [default: False]

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to the template's stored color, then #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to the template's stored color, then #AZURE).

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the written file in Notepad. [default: False]

commands.name: save
commands.description: Create or update (upsert) a named template from participants and default messages.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the template to create or update.

options.name: --participant
options.description: A participant as '[kind:]alias[:Display Name]'. Repeatable. Run 'cast kinds' to list kinds.

options.name: --message
options.description: A default message as 'Source -> Target : label'. Repeatable.

options.name: --title
options.description: Default diagram title.

options.name: --autonumber
options.description: Emit 'autonumber' by default when rendering this template. [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: Default PlantUML theme name (emits '!theme <name>').

options.name: --outer-box-color
options.description: Default color of the outer box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #PHYSICAL).

options.name: --inner-box-color
options.description: Default color of the inner box wrapping the non-actor participants (defaults to #AZURE).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print a saved template's stored definition.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the template to show.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the template to delete.

commands.name: explorer
commands.description: Open the folder where templates are stored in Visual Studio Code.
